scope: GSC-derived SEO analysis (rankings, visibility trend, keyword coverage) for bariatriccounselingcenter.com. Competitor #1-blocker and AI-visibility sections remain manual/out of scope for this pulse.
wins: "bariatric counseling" jumped from position 20.1 to 2.6 (delta +17.5), now BCC's top-ranking tracked term at 7 impressions and squarely in the #2-3 tier.

The hydration/weight-loss blog post (why-hydration-is-essential-for-weight-loss-and-management) is BCC's strongest organic asset: 4,406 impressions, position 6.8, 24 clicks — more impressions than any other page by a wide margin.
Three tracked terms are now holding page-1 #4-10 positions: "bariatric counseling near me" (8.0), "bariatric therapist" (8.4), and "bariatric surgery counseling" (9.0).

Several local/service terms are trending up double digits since their prior snapshot: "weight loss therapy san antonio" (25.0 -> 14.0, +11), "bariatric psychological evaluation near me" (36.2 -> 26.1, +10.1), "weight loss counseling" (27.4 -> 20.3, +7.2), and "overeaters help" (23.0 -> 16.0, +7.0).
Note: single-snapshot position swings on low-impression keywords are directional, not conclusive — several of these terms have single-digit impression counts.
needs_attention: Keyword coverage: 20 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show GSC impression data this snapshot (was 21/83 on 2026-09-09) — this is a keyword count, not a page count. It does not mean 63 pages are missing; many tracked keywords intentionally share one target page.

Tracker hygiene is in good shape: of 52 distinct target pages across the 83 tracked keywords, only 1 still points at a staging URL. That single stale pointer is a tracker-hygiene fix, not evidence of an unpublished page — most staging-targeted tracker URLs from earlier audits have already been confirmed to be live pages under the correct www slug.

Visibility has drifted down over the full 4-month window: impressions fell from 2,447 (2026-05-07) to 1,867 (2026-09-10), roughly a 24% decline, and impression-weighted average position worsened from 14.87 to 19.97 over the same span, though the last few days (20.09 on 09-08 to 19.97 on 09-10) show slight recovery.

Site-wide CTR is near zero: 1,867 impressions produced only 12 clicks (~0.6% CTR) this snapshot, and most individual tracked keywords show meaningful impressions with 0 recorded clicks (e.g. "weight loss therapy" — 36 impressions/0 clicks; "bariatric psychological evaluation near me" — 29 impressions/1 click).

Two commercial terms slipped hard: "weight loss counseling or therapy" fell from position 4.0 to 64.7 (delta -60.7, the largest single-keyword loss in the dataset) and "food addiction treatment" fell from 59.0 to 66.2 (delta -7.2), both with real impression volume (3 and 6 respectively). These moves are large enough to be worth investigating even accounting for normal day-to-day swing.
priority_actions: Repoint the single remaining staging-targeted keyword slug in keywords-master.json to its correct live www URL so GSC matching stays clean (tracker hygiene, not a publish task).

Investigate the "weight loss counseling or therapy" collapse (position 4 -> 65) specifically — check for de-indexing, a title/H1 change, cannibalization from a similar page, or a SERP layout change before assuming it's noise.

Add internal links/CTAs from the top-performing hydration blog post (4,406 impressions, position 6.8, only 24 clicks = ~0.5% CTR) into matching bariatric/weight-loss service pages to convert traffic BCC is already winning.

Review meta titles and descriptions for keywords that have real impressions but zero clicks (weight loss therapy, bariatric psychological evaluation near me, nutritional counseling san antonio tx) — likely a snippet/CTR problem rather than a ranking problem.

Reinforce the newly page-1 terms (bariatric counseling, bariatric counseling near me, bariatric therapist, bariatric surgery counseling) with on-page content updates and FAQ schema to defend and extend the gains.

If a staging-to-prod publish backlog needs to be assessed, confirm the real count via a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's own notes — do not infer an unpublished-page count from this GSC/keyword data, since staging cannot be observed directly.
summary: Visibility is down over the 4-month window but showing early signs of recovery, with one standout ranking win ("bariatric counseling" now #2-3) and three terms newly on page 1. The bigger opportunity is CTR: BCC is getting real impressions on commercial terms but converting almost none of them into clicks, and one term ("weight loss counseling or therapy") needs investigation for a sharp ranking drop.
